mechanism: Enzalutamide is a strong CYP3A4/CYP2C9 inducer; may reduce dofetilide exposure, though CYP2C9 induction is less relevant than renal pathway for dofetilide. Enzalutamide also causes QT prolongation additively.
action: Monitor QTc; avoid combination due to additive QT prolongation and potential altered dofetilide levels.
